collection_title_en: Utagawa Hiroshige — Nature Prints: Chū-tanzaku Format

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《菊与鹪鹩》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Bird and Chrysanthemums
works.blurb_zh: 细长的菊瓣向空处舒展，小鸟停在花丛上方。花的散开与鸟尾的竖起，让窄幅里有了轻快的起伏。
works.blurb_en: Long chrysanthemum petals reach into open space beneath a small bird. Their spreading lines answer the lift of its tail, giving the narrow print a buoyant rhythm.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 菊与柿在日本传统艺术中常承担秋季、乃至秋末向冬季过渡的时间提示。大都会关于日本季节图像的研究特别把菊与枝叶渐落的柿树列为秋冬题材的典型季节线索。
works.seasonal_note_en: Chrysanthemums and persimmons often serve as markers of autumn—and sometimes the transition from late autumn toward winter—in Japanese art. The Met specifically identifies chrysanthemums and persimmons on increasingly bare trees as characteristic autumnal and winter seasonal references.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《小鸟与重瓣樱》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Bird and Double Cherry
works.blurb_zh: 重瓣樱沿弯枝层层绽放，小鸟的红胸隐映在粉色花团之间。枝干连接上下两簇繁花，也留出一段清透的春日空气。
works.blurb_en: Clusters of double cherry blossom follow a curved branch around a red-breasted bird. Between the flowers above and below, a clear interval of spring air remains.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《小鸟与山樱》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Bird and Wild Cherry
works.blurb_zh: 山樱分据画幅的上下两端，小鸟沿斜枝俯身。视线随枝条穿过中央的空白，仿佛也经过了一次短暂停歇。
works.blurb_en: Wild cherry blossoms occupy opposite ends of the print as a bird leans along a slanting branch. The open middle offers a pause on the eye’s passage between them.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《芙蓉上的小鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Bird on Hibiscus
works.blurb_zh: 芙蓉的宽叶从下方托起花枝，小鸟藏身于花朵上方。淡花、深叶与羽色相叠，让这段枝头显得安静而丰厚。
works.blurb_en: Broad hibiscus leaves support a flowering stem, with a bird nestled above the bloom. Pale petals, dark foliage and feathers build a quiet density.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《蓝鸟与蔷薇》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Blue Bird and Roses
works.blurb_zh: 蓝鸟俯向沿画边垂落的蔷薇，深蓝羽色在红花间格外醒目。另一侧的大幅留白，使这一下探身显得轻盈。
works.blurb_en: A blue bird bends toward roses trailing down the edge. Its saturated feathers stand out among the red flowers, while the open opposite side lightens the gesture.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《蓝鸟与蜀葵》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Bluebird and Hollyhock
works.blurb_zh: 蓝色小鸟倒悬般探向蜀葵，尖尾与花茎形成相反的方向。高处尚未展开的花苞，把盛放之外的时间也留在画中。
works.blurb_en: A blue bird reaches down toward hollyhock flowers, its pointed tail opposing the stem’s direction. Unopened buds above preserve a moment before bloom.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山茶枝上的蓝鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Bluebird on Camellia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 山茶枝在上下两朵花之间转折，蓝鸟横栖其间。圆润的花冠与细直的尾羽相对，让视线在柔软和锐利之间往返。
works.blurb_en: A camellia branch turns between two blossoms, carrying a blue bird across its middle. Rounded petals and straight tail feathers offer contrasting shapes to follow.

works.title_en: Boar with Waterfall and Bush Clover
works.title_ja: 十二支　亥　萩､猪
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《瀑布、胡枝子与野猪》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Boar with Waterfall and Bush Clover
works.blurb_zh: 瀑布从岩壁间落下，胡枝子披垂在水声之上。野猪沉实的身躯占住下方，给飞流与细花添了一份重量。
works.blurb_en: Water drops through the rock beneath trailing bush clover. The boar’s solid body anchors the lower half, lending weight to the falling stream and delicate flowers.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《桃花间的公牛》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Bull Amid Peach Blossom
works.blurb_zh: 细碎桃花升向画幅上端，公牛低头立在树下。繁密的花枝与深色的躯体相衬，春意有了朴实而沉稳的尺度。
works.blurb_en: Small peach blossoms rise above a bull standing with its head lowered. The dark body steadies the flowering branches, giving spring a grounded presence.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《蝴蝶与胡枝子》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Butterflies and Bush Clover
works.blurb_zh: 胡枝子斜斜伸入空中，蝴蝶只留下几笔轻细的轮廓。花叶的密处与蝶翼的疏处之间，仿佛有风缓缓穿行。
works.blurb_en: Bush clover extends diagonally into the open field; butterflies appear as a few fine strokes. Air seems to pass between dense foliage and the sparse marks of wings.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山茶与文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Camellia and Finch
works.blurb_zh: 文鸟停在山茶的斜枝上，头部的红白小点与花色相应。高处的花苞和下方的盛花，把枝头分成不同的生长时刻。
works.blurb_en: The finch’s red and white head echoes the camellia flowers. Buds above and open blossoms below divide the branch into different moments of growth.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《雪中山茶》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Camellia Blossoms in Snow
works.blurb_zh: 积雪覆住曲折的山茶枝，红花却从白色边缘垂落。灰暗底色让雪与花都更鲜明，寒意中仍有柔软的亮处。
works.blurb_en: Snow caps the angular camellia branches, while red blossoms hang beyond its white edges. Against grey, both snow and petals become distinct points of light.
works.seasonal_note_zh: “雪中山茶”在日本花鸟画中并不矛盾。山茶类花木常被用于寒季图景；大都会艺术博物馆亦收藏广重《雪覆山茶与麻雀》，并在其他秋冬花鸟屏风中将山茶类列入冬季意象。这里的“花开于雪中”尤其适合被理解为冬末、向春天过渡的物候瞬间。
works.seasonal_note_en: Snow and camellia are not contradictory in Japanese bird-and-flower imagery. Camellias appear in cold-season imagery, and The Met holds Hiroshige’s *Sparrow and Snow-covered Camellia*. In seasonal programs, camellia can function as a winter motif. The combination is especially evocative of late winter and the threshold of spring.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《金丝雀与紫藤》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Canary and Wisteria
works.blurb_zh: 金黄色的小鸟依着紫藤细枝，低垂的花序与长藤一同向下。明亮羽色只占很小一处，却使整幅疏淡的画面活了起来。
works.blurb_en: A yellow bird rests among the fine stems of wisteria. Its small patch of brightness animates a pale field crossed by hanging flowers and a long trailing vine.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《菊花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Chrysanthemums
works.blurb_zh: 菊茎从下角斜升，细瓣在画边舒开。花朵并未占满纸面，空处让人看见茎叶之间清瘦而连续的线条。
works.blurb_en: Chrysanthemum stems rise from a lower corner, their fine petals opening at the edge. The unfilled paper makes the lean, continuous lines between leaves visible.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 菊与柿在日本传统艺术中常承担秋季、乃至秋末向冬季过渡的时间提示。大都会关于日本季节图像的研究特别把菊与枝叶渐落的柿树列为秋冬题材的典型季节线索。
works.seasonal_note_en: Chrysanthemums and persimmons often serve as markers of autumn—and sometimes the transition from late autumn toward winter—in Japanese art. The Met specifically identifies chrysanthemums and persimmons on increasingly bare trees as characteristic autumnal and winter seasonal references.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《铁线莲》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Clematis
works.blurb_zh: 铁线莲沿细藤上下展开，星形花瓣与分叉的叶片彼此呼应。纤细的攀援线把相隔的花叶串成一段舒缓的走势。
works.blurb_en: Star-shaped clematis flowers answer the divided leaves along a slender vine. Its climbing line joins the separated clusters into one unhurried movement.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹤与紫菀》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Crane and Asters
works.blurb_zh: 鹤低头收颈，层叠的羽片在花茎旁展开。修长双腿与紧凑的身体相对，静止的姿态里仍藏着细密的节奏。
works.blurb_en: The crane bends its neck beside flowering stems, revealing overlapping feathers. Slender legs contrast with its compact body, giving a still pose intricate rhythm.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹤与秋花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Crane and Autumn Flowers
works.blurb_zh: 鹤的细颈弯成一道曲线，与身旁直立的秋花相伴。淡墨似的羽身融入纸色，观看的重心落在轮廓而非浓彩上。
works.blurb_en: The crane’s neck curves beside upright autumn flowers. Its pale body merges with the paper, drawing attention to outline rather than strong colour.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 秋草并不是泛指“秋天的植物”，而是一套历史悠久的诗画语汇。月、芒草、胡枝子等组合自平安时代以来便频繁唤起秋夜、清寂与怀旧感，因此这类作品的季节性通常比现代植物花期判断更明确。
works.seasonal_note_en: “Autumn grasses” are more than a generic botanical label: they belong to a long poetic and pictorial vocabulary. Combinations of moon, pampas grass, bush clover, and other autumn plants have evoked autumn nights, clarity, and nostalgia since the Heian period, making their seasonal meaning especially strong.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹤与秋草》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Crane and Autumn Grasses
works.blurb_zh: 鹤在秋草间俯首，展开的羽缘像一排清晰的笔画。草叶向上挑起，鸟身向下收拢，两种方向在狭幅里相遇。
works.blurb_en: A crane bows among autumn grasses, its feather edges distinct as strokes of a brush. Rising blades meet the downward fold of the bird’s body.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 秋草并不是泛指“秋天的植物”，而是一套历史悠久的诗画语汇。月、芒草、胡枝子等组合自平安时代以来便频繁唤起秋夜、清寂与怀旧感，因此这类作品的季节性通常比现代植物花期判断更明确。
works.seasonal_note_en: “Autumn grasses” are more than a generic botanical label: they belong to a long poetic and pictorial vocabulary. Combinations of moon, pampas grass, bush clover, and other autumn plants have evoked autumn nights, clarity, and nostalgia since the Heian period, making their seasonal meaning especially strong.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《雨中飞翔的杜鹃》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Cuckoo Flying through Rain
works.blurb_zh: 斜雨贯穿纸面，杜鹃在高处振翅，树梢压在下角。鸟、雨线与枝叶各循其势，使空中也有了可见的速度。
works.blurb_en: Slanting rain crosses the sheet beneath a flying cuckoo, with treetops confined to a lower corner. Wings, rain and branches give the open air a sense of speed.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹿与瀑布》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Deer and Waterfall
works.blurb_zh: 鹿立在瀑布旁回首，细白水线从深色岩面落下。斑点、石纹与飞流相互映照，幽暗山间因这些小亮处而清晰。
works.blurb_en: A deer turns beside a waterfall, where pale streams descend over dark rock. Spots, stone textures and falling water bring small points of clarity to the shaded scene.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《盛开的重瓣樱》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Double Cherry in Flower
works.blurb_zh: 重瓣樱密密铺在画幅一侧，花团几乎连成柔软的长带。另一侧的题字与空纸，使繁盛仍有可以呼吸的边界。
works.blurb_en: Double cherry blossoms gather into an almost continuous band along one side. Inscription and open paper on the other give this abundance room to breathe.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《蜻蜓与秋海棠》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Dragonfly and Begonia
works.blurb_zh: 海棠细茎托着几朵浅花，蜻蜓横过花间。薄翼的轻与深色叶片的重相衬，让一个微小的停留也变得可见。
works.blurb_en: A dragonfly crosses the pale flowers held on fine begonia stems. Its light wings contrast with a broad dark leaf, making a small pause perceptible.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鸭与芦苇》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Ducks and Reeds
works.blurb_zh: 两只鸭沿弯曲水带错落，一只收拢，一只侧向前方。芦苇穿过水面，把柔缓的波纹分出几道纤细的节拍。
works.blurb_en: Two ducks sit at different points along a curving band of water. Reeds interrupt the soft ripples with a few slender, measured lines.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 芦苇本身不足以把一幅作品机械归入“秋”。在日本季节图像中，芦可以跨越较长物候期；真正具有强冬季指向的是“枯芦”等明确状态。网页的季节判断应结合落花、鸟类、天气与植物状态，而不是仅凭标题中出现 Reeds。
works.seasonal_note_en: Reeds alone are not enough to assign a work mechanically to autumn. In Japanese seasonal imagery they can span a broad part of the year; explicitly withered reeds carry a much stronger winter association. Season should therefore be read together with falling petals, birds, weather, and the condition of the plant rather than from the word “reeds” alone.

works.title_en: Falcon on an Ivy-draped Pine Branch
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹰栖覆蔦松枝》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Falcon on an Ivy-draped Pine Branch
works.blurb_zh: 鹰贴着松干静栖，细密羽纹与成簇松针并置。垂落的蔦叶添入红色，让严整的鸟身也处在枝叶的变化之中。
works.blurb_en: A falcon rests close to the pine trunk, patterned feathers beside clustered needles. Red trailing ivy introduces change around the bird’s composed silhouette.

works.title_en: Falcon on Perch, Sparrow, and Narcissus
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《栖鹰、麻雀与水仙》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Falcon on Perch, Sparrow, and Narcissus
works.blurb_zh: 鹰端坐栖架，麻雀在上方掠过，水仙从下角伸起。小鸟的自由飞动与鹰的端凝相对，画面因此多了一层张力。
works.blurb_en: A falcon sits on its perch while a sparrow passes overhead and narcissus rises below. The smaller bird’s flight sets the falcon’s stillness in relief.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 水仙在日本季节图像中常属于寒季。大都会一件《秋冬花鸟》屏风明确把水仙与山茶、枯芦、鸳鸯等安排在冬景一侧。因此这幅作品虽可被现代花期直觉理解为“早春”，在传统季节语汇中也带有很强的冬末意味。
works.seasonal_note_en: Narcissus often belongs to the cold-season vocabulary of Japanese art. In The Met’s *Birds and Flowers of Autumn and Winter*, narcissus appears on the winter side together with camellia, withered reeds, and mandarin ducks. A modern viewer may read it as early spring, but traditional seasonal imagery also gives it a strong late-winter resonance.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山茶枝上的文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Camellia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 一朵浅色山茶舒展在下方，文鸟沿枝轻轻侧身。淡花与灰羽彼此接近，深绿叶片则把柔和的轮廓衬了出来。
works.blurb_en: A pale camellia opens below a finch turned slightly on its branch. Soft petals and grey feathers share a gentle register, edged by dark green leaves.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山茶枝上的文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Camellia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 文鸟栖在直上的细枝，红花贴近下角。小小红颊与花瓣遥相呼应，把看似分散的上下两端连在一起。
works.blurb_en: A finch perches on an ascending stem above a red camellia. Its small red cheek answers the petals below, joining the separated ends of the composition.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山茶枝上的文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Camellia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 红山茶压住画幅下方，文鸟从侧枝回望。长尾斜落在空纸上，使花叶的密处与轻巧的鸟身保持距离。
works.blurb_en: A red camellia anchors the lower field while a finch looks back from a side branch. Its long tail falls across bare paper, separating the bird from the dense foliage.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山茶枝上的文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Camellia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 文鸟位于两簇花叶之间，细枝绕过大段空白。蓝色边缘与浅色羽身相映，使枝头显出清凉、通透的层次。
works.blurb_en: A finch sits between clusters of camellia leaves and blossoms, with bare paper around the stem. Blue at the edges sharpens the clarity of its pale feathers.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山茶枝上的文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Camellia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 文鸟与山茶集中在一道斜枝上，花朵向两端展开。略显温厚的纸色包住细线与淡羽，让目光停在近处的枝头。
works.blurb_en: Finch and camellias share a diagonal branch, blossoms opening toward either end. Warm paper surrounds fine lines and pale feathers, keeping attention close to the branch.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《木兰枝上的文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Magnolia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 木兰花在高处张开，文鸟俯身探向枝下。弯折的细枝留下大片空处，鸟喙的方向便成了观看的线索。
works.blurb_en: Magnolia flowers open above a finch leaning below its branch. The bent stem leaves ample space, allowing the direction of the beak to guide the eye.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《红梅枝上的文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Red Plum Branch
works.blurb_zh: 梅花沿细枝散开，文鸟立在粗枝转折之处。淡花与暗羽相衬，粗细不一的枝条让这个停驻显得稳妥而自然。
works.blurb_en: Plum blossoms scatter along fine twigs around a finch on the bend of a heavier branch. Pale flowers and dark feathers meet within a structure of contrasting line weights.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 梅花是日本艺术中重要的早春信号之一；它常在寒意尚存时开放，因此“梅”所指向的并不是完全摆脱冬天后的暖春，而更接近冬末至初春的季节交界。
works.seasonal_note_en: Plum blossom is a major early-spring signal in Japanese art. Because it flowers while the cold still lingers, it often evokes the threshold from late winter into early spring rather than a fully established warm spring.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《紫藤上的山雀》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Finch on Wisteria Vine
works.blurb_zh: 紫藤花序垂在高处，小鸟攀住一根斜向细藤。长长的藤线穿过空纸，把一团繁花与一个轻小身影联系起来。
works.blurb_en: Wisteria hangs above a bird gripping a sloping tendril. The long line through bare paper connects abundant flowers with a slight, suspended body.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《盛开的梅树》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Flowering Plum Tree
works.blurb_zh: 梅枝几乎竖直地伸向画顶，红花疏密相间地附着其上。老干的弯曲留在下方，向上的新枝显得格外清劲。
works.blurb_en: Plum shoots rise almost straight to the top, carrying red blossoms at uneven intervals. The old trunk’s bend below makes their upward lines especially crisp.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 梅花是日本艺术中重要的早春信号之一；它常在寒意尚存时开放，因此“梅”所指向的并不是完全摆脱冬天后的暖春，而更接近冬末至初春的季节交界。
works.seasonal_note_en: Plum blossom is a major early-spring signal in Japanese art. Because it flowers while the cold still lingers, it often evokes the threshold from late winter into early spring rather than a fully established warm spring.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《飞燕与菖蒲》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Flying Swallows and Iris
works.blurb_zh: 燕子在菖蒲上方交错飞过，张开的翅膀占住高处。下方笔直的叶与花，把空中的转折衬得更轻、更快。
works.blurb_en: Swallows cross above iris flowers, open wings occupying the upper field. Upright leaves below sharpen the light, quick turns overhead.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《飞雁掠过满月》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Geese Flying across Full Moon
works.blurb_zh: 雁翼切过满月边缘，月的圆与鸟身的斜线彼此相碰。深蓝云气把明亮月面托出，飞行因此有了辽阔的背景。
works.blurb_en: Goose wings cross the full moon’s edge, setting diagonal bodies against its circle. Deep blue cloud frames the light and gives their flight an expansive setting.
works.seasonal_note_zh: “月与雁”是高度明确的秋季组合。大都会艺术博物馆指出，广重《满月下的雁》所表现的是阴历八月的满月——传统东亚语境中的秋季高点；在日本四季绘画里，成群飞雁本身也常用来提示秋天。
works.seasonal_note_en: Moon and geese form a strongly autumnal combination. The Met notes that Hiroshige’s image of wild geese crossing the full moon refers to the full moon of the eighth lunar month, the height of autumn. In Japanese four-season painting, a flock of geese is also a conventional marker of autumn.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《飞雁掠过满月》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Geese Flying across Full Moon
works.blurb_zh: 大轮月色占据上方，两只雁沿月前翻转而下。下端浓蓝的云带收住画面，让飞鸟与明月之间保留清澈的距离。
works.blurb_en: A large moon fills the upper field as two geese turn downward before it. The deep blue cloud below preserves a clear interval between birds and light.
works.seasonal_note_zh: “月与雁”是高度明确的秋季组合。大都会艺术博物馆指出，广重《满月下的雁》所表现的是阴历八月的满月——传统东亚语境中的秋季高点；在日本四季绘画里，成群飞雁本身也常用来提示秋天。
works.seasonal_note_en: Moon and geese form a strongly autumnal combination. The Met notes that Hiroshige’s image of wild geese crossing the full moon refers to the full moon of the eighth lunar month, the height of autumn. In Japanese four-season painting, a flock of geese is also a conventional marker of autumn.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《锦鸡与竹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Golden Pheasant and Bamboo
works.blurb_zh: 锦鸡沿竹枝俯身，长尾几乎挑到画幅上端。尖细竹叶与尾羽同向伸展，使浓丽的鸟身仍带着线条的轻捷。
works.blurb_en: A golden pheasant leans along bamboo, its long tail reaching nearly to the top. Pointed leaves echo the feathers, lending linear lightness to the richly coloured body.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《锦鸡与蕨芽》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Golden Pheasant and Fern Shoots
works.blurb_zh: 锦鸡低下头，长尾从饱满的羽身一路升起。身旁卷曲的蕨芽短而细，与夸张的尾线形成有趣的尺度对照。
works.blurb_en: The pheasant lowers its head as its tail rises far above the rounded body. Small curled fern shoots offer a striking contrast in scale.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《柳树上的锦鸡》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Golden Pheasant in Willow Tree
works.blurb_zh: 锦鸡停在弯曲柳干旁，细长尾羽顺着树势垂下。柳丝从上方披落，与鸟尾一同拉长了这段安静的树影。
works.blurb_en: A golden pheasant rests beside a curved willow trunk, its tail following the downward turn. Hanging willow strands extend the same quiet movement.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《纺织娘与牵牛花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Grasshopper and Morning Glories
works.blurb_zh: 牵牛藤从上方垂入，细小的纺织娘藏在叶间。画面把许多空间留给纤细茎线，微小生命需要靠近才看得清。
works.blurb_en: A morning-glory vine descends from above, sheltering a small grasshopper among its leaves. Fine stems occupy the open field and invite a closer look.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《芙蓉》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Hibiscus
works.blurb_zh: 红芙蓉与未开的花苞并列，宽叶在下面层层展开。花瓣的薄与叶面的厚相映，一根花茎便有了丰足的层次。
works.blurb_en: A red hibiscus stands beside an unopened bud above broad leaves. Thin petals and substantial foliage give a single stem a full range of textures.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《芙蓉》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Hibiscus
works.blurb_zh: 芙蓉沿直立的花茎分布，盛花在下，花苞向上。浅蓝底色穿过叶片间隙，使花的生长显得疏朗而连续。
works.blurb_en: Hibiscus blooms sit low on an upright stem, with buds continuing upward. Pale blue between the leaves keeps its growth open and continuous.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《芙蓉与黑枕黄鹂》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Hibiscus and Black-naped Oriole
works.blurb_zh: 黄鹂栖在芙蓉花上方，暖色羽身与红花相邻。背景的一道蓝弧横过枝后，给近处的花鸟添出一层清凉的远意。
works.blurb_en: An oriole’s warm feathers sit close to a red hibiscus. A blue curve behind the branch introduces a cooler sense of distance.

works.title_en: Japanese Pampas Grass, Bush Clover and Red-headed Crane
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《芒草、胡枝子与丹顶鹤》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Japanese Pampas Grass, Bush Clover and Red-headed Crane
works.blurb_zh: 白鹤立在胡枝子与芒草之间，细颈收成柔和的弯。浅羽从深色花叶中显出，草穗又把视线引向更高的空处。
works.blurb_en: A white crane stands among bush clover and pampas grass, its neck softly folded. Dark flowers define the pale feathers as grass stems lead upward into space.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 秋草并不是泛指“秋天的植物”，而是一套历史悠久的诗画语汇。月、芒草、胡枝子等组合自平安时代以来便频繁唤起秋夜、清寂与怀旧感，因此这类作品的季节性通常比现代植物花期判断更明确。
works.seasonal_note_en: “Autumn grasses” are more than a generic botanical label: they belong to a long poetic and pictorial vocabulary. Combinations of moon, pampas grass, bush clover, and other autumn plants have evoked autumn nights, clarity, and nostalgia since the Heian period, making their seasonal meaning especially strong.

works.title_en: Japanese White-eyes on a Maple Branch
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《枫枝上的绣眼鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Japanese White-eyes on a Maple Branch
works.blurb_zh: 两只绣眼鸟挤在一段细枝上，红叶分散在上下两端。小小身影的相依，成为稀疏秋色中最亲近的一笔。
works.blurb_en: Two white-eyes share a short stretch of twig between scattered maple leaves. Their closeness becomes the intimate centre of the sparse autumn colour.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 红叶、枫叶是日本艺术中最容易辨认的秋季物候之一。这里把作品归入秋季，主要依据的是季节性叶色，而不是鸟或动物本身。
works.seasonal_note_en: Maple foliage is one of the most legible autumnal signs in Japanese seasonal imagery. The autumn classification here is driven primarily by the changing leaves rather than by the accompanying bird or animal.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《翠鸟与绣球花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Kingfisher and Hydrangea
works.blurb_zh: 绣球花团占住上角，翠鸟从下方斜掠而过。圆密花序与锐利的喙、翅相对，让繁花旁的空处充满动势。
works.blurb_en: Hydrangea clusters fill an upper corner as a kingfisher sweeps below. Rounded flowers contrast with sharp beak and wings, setting the adjoining space in motion.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《翠鸟与花菖蒲》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Kingfisher and Iris
works.blurb_zh: 翠鸟悬在高处，花菖蒲立于下方，两者之间隔着一段空白。长叶将目光向上引，仿佛接住鸟身短暂的停顿。
works.blurb_en: A kingfisher hangs above irises, separated from them by open paper. The long leaves lead upward toward the bird’s momentary suspension.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《翠鸟与燕子花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Kingfisher and Iris
works.blurb_zh: 翠鸟张翼俯冲，直立的菖蒲花茎从下方迎向它。鸟身与花之间没有繁密背景，只有一段清楚的飞行距离。
works.blurb_en: A kingfisher dives with wings spread toward upright iris stems. With no dense background between them, the distance of its flight remains clear.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《翠鸟与芦苇》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Kingfisher and Reeds
works.blurb_zh: 翠鸟低头停在芦苇间，斑斓羽背缩成一小团。周围细长而弯折的苇茎，把这份安静衬得既轻微又专注。
works.blurb_en: A kingfisher lowers its head among reeds, its patterned back gathered into a small shape. Bent, slender stems frame a quiet concentration.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 芦苇本身不足以把一幅作品机械归入“秋”。在日本季节图像中，芦可以跨越较长物候期；真正具有强冬季指向的是“枯芦”等明确状态。网页的季节判断应结合落花、鸟类、天气与植物状态，而不是仅凭标题中出现 Reeds。
works.seasonal_note_en: Reeds alone are not enough to assign a work mechanically to autumn. In Japanese seasonal imagery they can span a broad part of the year; explicitly withered reeds carry a much stronger winter association. Season should therefore be read together with falling petals, birds, weather, and the condition of the plant rather than from the word “reeds” alone.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《翠鸟与荚蒾》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Kingfisher and Viburnum
works.blurb_zh: 白色花序簇拥着翠鸟，蓝翼从花叶间张开。圆花与尖羽相互穿插，使繁密的枝头仍有可以辨认的飞动方向。
works.blurb_en: White flower clusters surround a kingfisher’s opening blue wings. Rounded blooms and pointed feathers interweave without obscuring the direction of flight.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《翠鸟与泽泻》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Kingfisher and Water Plantain
works.blurb_zh: 翠鸟立在泽泻细茎上，长喙指向开阔的一侧。宽叶垂在下方，细小花朵点在中间，让不同尺度在一枝之内相遇。
works.blurb_en: A kingfisher points its long beak toward open space above water plantain. Broad leaves and tiny flowers bring contrasting scales together on one stem.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《狮子与牡丹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Lion and Peonies
works.blurb_zh: 狮子卷曲的鬃毛与牡丹花瓣层层相叠，几乎填满中段。深色旋纹包围着花的柔软，画面在厚重中显出细致。
works.blurb_en: The lion’s curled mane overlaps layered peony petals through the centre. Dark whorls surround the softness of flowers, making a dense image finely articulated.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《绿色小鸟与菊花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Little Green Birds and Chrysanthemums
works.blurb_zh: 两只黄绿小鸟沿花枝上下相随，菊瓣向旁边细细散开。鸟身的圆团与花瓣的长线交替，让窄幅有了轻巧的层次。
works.blurb_en: Two yellow-green birds follow the flower stem at different heights. Rounded bodies alternate with the long lines of chrysanthemum petals.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 菊与柿在日本传统艺术中常承担秋季、乃至秋末向冬季过渡的时间提示。大都会关于日本季节图像的研究特别把菊与枝叶渐落的柿树列为秋冬题材的典型季节线索。
works.seasonal_note_en: Chrysanthemums and persimmons often serve as markers of autumn—and sometimes the transition from late autumn toward winter—in Japanese art. The Met specifically identifies chrysanthemums and persimmons on increasingly bare trees as characteristic autumnal and winter seasonal references.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《长尾鸟与芙蓉》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Long-tailed Bird and Hibiscus
works.blurb_zh: 长尾鸟张翼掠过芙蓉，尾羽拖向画幅下端。花朵静静占住上方，飞鸟则把花下的空处拉成一段流动的线。
works.blurb_en: A long-tailed bird opens its wings beside hibiscus, its tail trailing to the lower edge. Still flowers above give way to a flowing line below.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《桃花枝上的长尾鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Long-tailed Bird on Blossoming Peach
works.blurb_zh: 长尾鸟栖在桃花斜枝上，蓝尾顺着垂枝伸下。小花沿枝散布，让明丽羽色有了一圈轻柔的陪衬。
works.blurb_en: A long-tailed bird rests on flowering peach, its blue tail following a hanging stem. Scattered blossoms soften the setting around its bright plumage.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《葡萄藤上的金刚鹦鹉》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Macaw on Grapevine
works.blurb_zh: 金刚鹦鹉的红身蓝翼夹在葡萄叶与果串之间。藤蔓的弯绕与坚挺尾羽相对，使浓色也能在空纸上显得清楚。
works.blurb_en: A macaw’s red body and blue wings sit between grape leaves and fruit. Curving tendrils oppose its firm tail, keeping the rich colours distinct against bare paper.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《蔦藤上的金刚鹦鹉》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Macaw on Ivy Vine
works.blurb_zh: 鹦鹉攀在蔦藤旁，红羽与深色叶片贴得很近。藤端细细垂入下方空处，延长了鸟身之外的安静。
works.blurb_en: A parrot clings beside ivy, red feathers close to dark leaves. Fine trailing ends extend the stillness below the bird.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《松枝上的金刚鹦鹉》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Macaw on Pine Branch
works.blurb_zh: 鹦鹉端立松枝，蓝色长尾垂过大片空白。圆簇松针分别托住上下两端，鲜亮鸟身因此显得稳稳当当。
works.blurb_en: A parrot stands upright on pine, its blue tail hanging across open paper. Clusters of needles balance the bright body above and below.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《喜鹊与杜鹃花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Magpie and Azalea
works.blurb_zh: 喜鹊的长尾沿弯枝落下，杜鹃花在低处绽开。高处的小小鸟身与下方花簇遥相联系，整幅像一道拉长的弧。
works.blurb_en: A magpie’s tail descends along a curved branch toward azaleas below. The small body above and the flowers beneath describe an extended arc.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鸳鸯》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Mandarin Ducks
works.blurb_zh: 鸳鸯收颈贴近芦苇，圆转的羽纹与弯曲苇线相接。温黄纸色让细部显得含蓄，需要缓慢辨认鸟身的起伏。
works.blurb_en: A mandarin duck folds its neck near reeds, curved plumage meeting bent stems. The warm paper gives the contours a subdued presence that rewards slow looking.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 鸳鸯本身并不是只能属于某一个季节；它还具有成双、和合等独立象征意义。不过在某些日本“秋冬花鸟”的季节编排里，鸳鸯确实被放入冬景。因此网页不宜仅凭“鸳鸯”自动判定季节，应结合竹、雪、冰、枯芦等环境线索阅读。
works.seasonal_note_en: Mandarin ducks are not exclusive to a single season; they also carry independent associations of pairing and harmony. Yet in some Japanese autumn-and-winter seasonal programs they appear in winter scenes. The website therefore should not assign season from “mandarin duck” alone, but read it together with snow, ice, bamboo, withered reeds, and other environmental clues.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《雪堤上的鸳鸯》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Mandarin Duck on Snowbank
works.blurb_zh: 鸳鸯伏在雪岸边，圆润的羽身贴着斜向白地。深红与黑色围出一个安稳的形状，寒水只在下角露出蓝意。
works.blurb_en: A mandarin duck rests against the sloping white of a snowbank. Red and black enclose a settled form above a small glimpse of blue water.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 这类作品的冬季感主要来自“雪”，而不只是鸳鸯本身。日本四季图像中，雪是明确的冬季标志；鸳鸯在部分秋冬花鸟图中也会出现在冬景一侧，因此两者结合时冬意非常清楚。
works.seasonal_note_en: The winter reading here comes primarily from snow, not from the mandarin duck alone. Snow is an explicit winter marker in Japanese four-season imagery, and mandarin ducks also appear on the winter side of some autumn-and-winter bird-and-flower programs.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鸳鸯与竹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Mandarin Ducks and Bamboo
works.blurb_zh: 鸳鸯相伴浮在弧形水纹间，竹叶从上方探入。浓丽羽色由清简的水线托住，热闹的色彩也有平静的去处。
works.blurb_en: Mandarin ducks float within curved water lines beneath bamboo leaves. Their rich plumage rests on a spare, calm structure.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 鸳鸯本身并不是只能属于某一个季节；它还具有成双、和合等独立象征意义。不过在某些日本“秋冬花鸟”的季节编排里，鸳鸯确实被放入冬景。因此网页不宜仅凭“鸳鸯”自动判定季节，应结合竹、雪、冰、枯芦等环境线索阅读。
works.seasonal_note_en: Mandarin ducks are not exclusive to a single season; they also carry independent associations of pairing and harmony. Yet in some Japanese autumn-and-winter seasonal programs they appear in winter scenes. The website therefore should not assign season from “mandarin duck” alone, but read it together with snow, ice, bamboo, withered reeds, and other environmental clues.

works.title_en: Mandarin Ducks and Falling Leaves on Ice
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《冰上鸳鸯与落叶》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Mandarin Ducks and Falling Leaves on Ice
works.blurb_zh: 落叶绕着收拢的鸳鸯飘下，羽身的圆纹映着冰面的蓝。柔软的曲线聚在一起，空处则留给了渐冷的天气。
works.blurb_en: Falling leaves surround the folded ducks, whose rounded markings meet the blue of ice. Soft curves gather together within an increasingly spare setting.
works.seasonal_note_zh: “冰上鸳鸯与落叶”处在一个很适合表现季节交替的时间点：落叶暗示深秋，而结冰的水面把画面推向初冬。与其硬分成单一季节，更适合把它理解为“晚秋至初冬”的过渡景象。
works.seasonal_note_en: Mandarin ducks on ice with fallen leaves evoke a seasonal threshold: fallen leaves suggest late autumn, while ice pushes the scene toward early winter. Rather than forcing a single-season reading, it is better understood as a late-autumn-to-early-winter transition.

works.title_zh: 冰上鸳鸯与落叶（主版墨印）
works.title_en: Mandarin Ducks and Falling Leaves on Ice — Key Block Impression
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《冰上鸳鸯与落叶（主版墨印）》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Mandarin Ducks and Falling Leaves on Ice — Key Block Impression
works.blurb_zh: 少了浓彩，鸳鸯的羽纹、弯颈与落叶都化为清楚的线。主版墨印让视线停在轮廓之间，看见构图本身的轻重。
works.blurb_en: Without the rich colour, plumage, curved necks and falling leaves become distinct lines. The key-block impression brings the composition’s balance into view.
works.seasonal_note_zh: “冰上鸳鸯与落叶”处在一个很适合表现季节交替的时间点：落叶暗示深秋，而结冰的水面把画面推向初冬。与其硬分成单一季节，更适合把它理解为“晚秋至初冬”的过渡景象。
works.seasonal_note_en: Mandarin ducks on ice with fallen leaves evoke a seasonal threshold: fallen leaves suggest late autumn, while ice pushes the scene toward early winter. Rather than forcing a single-season reading, it is better understood as a late-autumn-to-early-winter transition.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鸳鸯与雪竹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Mandarin Ducks and Snow-covered Bamboo
works.blurb_zh: 鸳鸯浮在几圈水纹中，雪竹斜覆其上。鸟身的暖色与竹雪的冷白相邻，显出严寒中一小处柔和的生气。
works.blurb_en: Mandarin ducks sit within a few ripples beneath snowy bamboo. Warm plumage beside cold white creates a small pocket of softness.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 这类作品的冬季感主要来自“雪”，而不只是鸳鸯本身。日本四季图像中，雪是明确的冬季标志；鸳鸯在部分秋冬花鸟图中也会出现在冬景一侧，因此两者结合时冬意非常清楚。
works.seasonal_note_en: The winter reading here comes primarily from snow, not from the mandarin duck alone. Snow is an explicit winter marker in Japanese four-season imagery, and mandarin ducks also appear on the winter side of some autumn-and-winter bird-and-flower programs.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《牵牛花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Morning Glories
works.blurb_zh: 牵牛花攀向高处，深浅不同的花冠夹在浓叶之间。细藤继续越过盛花向上，仿佛生长还没有在画边结束。
works.blurb_en: Morning glories climb through dense leaves, their trumpets varying in colour. A fine vine continues above the blooms, carrying growth toward the edge.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《牵牛花与文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Morning Glories and Finch
works.blurb_zh: 文鸟立在牵牛细藤上，圆眼与红喙点亮浅色脸颊。花叶集中在上端，下面的空处把鸟身托得格外轻。
works.blurb_en: A finch’s round eye and red beak brighten its pale face on a morning-glory vine. Flowers above and open paper below make its perch seem weightless.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《黄鹂与铁线莲》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Oriole and Clematis
works.blurb_zh: 黄鹂在两段花枝之间展翼，身体斜穿中央空隙。花叶从上下探入，让飞行像一次从枝头到枝头的短途穿越。
works.blurb_en: An oriole opens its wings between two flowering branches. Foliage entering from above and below turns the flight into a short passage between perches.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《海棠枝上的小鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Oriole on Aronia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 小鸟停在花枝的转折处，一簇红花在脚下展开。上方疏疏的花叶延长了枝势，使沉静的鸟身不显孤立。
works.blurb_en: A bird rests at the turn of a flowering stem above a red cluster. Sparse flowers higher up continue the branch and give its still body a setting.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《都鸟、芦苇与落花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Oyster-catchers (Miyakodori), Reeds, and Falling Petals
works.blurb_zh: 都鸟贴近水面相伴，落花从细苇旁飘下。花瓣、苇尖与浅浅水纹都很轻，鸟身便成为这段水际的重心。
works.blurb_en: Shorebirds gather near the water as petals fall beside reeds. Light petals and ripples leave their bodies as the centre of gravity.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 芦苇本身不足以把一幅作品机械归入“秋”。在日本季节图像中，芦可以跨越较长物候期；真正具有强冬季指向的是“枯芦”等明确状态。网页的季节判断应结合落花、鸟类、天气与植物状态，而不是仅凭标题中出现 Reeds。
works.seasonal_note_en: Reeds alone are not enough to assign a work mechanically to autumn. In Japanese seasonal imagery they can span a broad part of the year; explicitly withered reeds carry a much stronger winter association. Season should therefore be read together with falling petals, birds, weather, and the condition of the plant rather than from the word “reeds” alone.

works.title_zh: 鹦鹉与绣球花、麻雀与铁线莲
works.title_en: Parrot and Hydrangeas, Sparrow and Clematis
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹦鹉与绣球花、麻雀与铁线莲》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Parrot and Hydrangeas, Sparrow and Clematis
works.blurb_zh: 上下两组花鸟各有一段枝头，叶片与空纸把它们隔开。目光从一处停栖移向另一处，如同读到相邻的两行短句。
works.blurb_en: Two flower-and-bird groups occupy separate stretches of branch. Leaves and bare paper divide them into neighbouring passages for the eye to read.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《枫树上的孔雀》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Peacock in a Maple Tree
works.blurb_zh: 孔雀的长尾垂过枫干，眼状羽斑沿画幅一路排列。红叶停在高处，细丽的尾纹则把秋色缓缓带向下方。
works.blurb_en: A peacock’s tail falls down the maple trunk, its eye markings running through the print. Red leaves above give way to the slow detail of feathers below.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 红叶、枫叶是日本艺术中最容易辨认的秋季物候之一。这里把作品归入秋季，主要依据的是季节性叶色，而不是鸟或动物本身。
works.seasonal_note_en: Maple foliage is one of the most legible autumnal signs in Japanese seasonal imagery. The autumn classification here is driven primarily by the changing leaves rather than by the accompanying bird or animal.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《牡丹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Peonies
works.blurb_zh: 牡丹在上下两端舒展，叶茎斜斜贯穿其间。浅色花瓣边缘的一抹红，让盛花既饱满又有透气的轮廓。
works.blurb_en: Peonies open at different heights along a diagonal stem. Red edging on pale petals gives the full blooms an airy outline.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《牡丹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Peonies
works.blurb_zh: 黄红相间的牡丹簇在画面一侧，深叶藏在层叠花瓣后。大片沉静底色让花的繁复集中显现，而不向四周散开。
works.blurb_en: Yellow and red peonies gather along one side, dark leaves behind layered petals. The quiet field concentrates their complexity.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《牡丹与小鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Peony and Bird
works.blurb_zh: 小鸟立在一朵盛牡丹上，细脚几乎融进花瓣。挺直的鸟身与蓬松花冠相对，使繁花中也有一个清醒的停顿。
works.blurb_en: A small bird stands above an open peony, its feet nearly lost among petals. Its upright body makes a crisp pause within the abundant bloom.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《柿子与绣眼鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Persimmons and Japanese White-eye
works.blurb_zh: 熟柿沉沉悬在上方，两只绣眼鸟沿曲枝分开。圆果与细鸟的尺度相差鲜明，一根枝条便承起了丰实与轻巧。
works.blurb_en: A ripe persimmon hangs above two white-eyes spaced along a curved twig. The round fruit and slight birds place fullness and lightness on the same branch.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 菊与柿在日本传统艺术中常承担秋季、乃至秋末向冬季过渡的时间提示。大都会关于日本季节图像的研究特别把菊与枝叶渐落的柿树列为秋冬题材的典型季节线索。
works.seasonal_note_en: Chrysanthemums and persimmons often serve as markers of autumn—and sometimes the transition from late autumn toward winter—in Japanese art. The Met specifically identifies chrysanthemums and persimmons on increasingly bare trees as characteristic autumnal and winter seasonal references.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《宠猴与红叶》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Pet Monkey and Maple Leaves
works.blurb_zh: 小猴抱住细枝，蓝色衣纹夹在红叶之间。卷曲的尾与弯折树枝相伴，让这个近人的身影仍融在秋日枝头。
works.blurb_en: A small monkey grips a slender branch, blue clothing among red leaves. Its curled tail echoes the wood’s bends and keeps the figure within the autumn setting.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 红叶、枫叶是日本艺术中最容易辨认的秋季物候之一。这里把作品归入秋季，主要依据的是季节性叶色，而不是鸟或动物本身。
works.seasonal_note_en: Maple foliage is one of the most legible autumnal signs in Japanese seasonal imagery. The autumn classification here is driven primarily by the changing leaves rather than by the accompanying bird or animal.

works.title_en: Pheasant on a Snow-covered Pine Tree
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《雪松上的雉鸡》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Pheasant on a Snow-covered Pine Tree
works.blurb_zh: 雉鸡静立雪松，长尾沿覆雪的枝条垂下。深羽、松针与白雪层次分明，把寒日的沉静凝在一段树身上。
works.blurb_en: A pheasant stands on snowy pine, its tail following a coated branch. Dark feathers, needles and white snow hold a winter stillness in distinct layers.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 这里的冬季判断首先来自画面中明确的积雪。日本四季图像长期以雪和萧疏景物提示冬季；植物或鸟类在这里是对冬景的补充，而不是季节判定的唯一依据。
works.seasonal_note_en: The winter reading here is anchored first of all by visible snow. Japanese four-season imagery has long used snow and spare landscapes as clear signs of winter; the plant or bird supplements that setting rather than determining the season by itself.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《石竹与藤袴》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Pinks and Fujibakama
works.blurb_zh: 石竹红花低处盛放，藤袴细小花序向上散开。两种花的大小与疏密不同，共同撑起一幅清瘦的草木图。
works.blurb_en: Red pinks open below the smaller clusters of fujibakama. Their differing scales and densities form a slender study of flowering stems.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《石竹与蜗牛》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Pinks and Snails
works.blurb_zh: 石竹的细茎交错上升，红花点在枝梢，蜗牛藏在近处。大段空白让这些微小差别不被繁叶遮住。
works.blurb_en: Fine stems of pinks cross upward, with red flowers at their tips and a snail close by. Open paper keeps the small details available to the eye.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《千鸟、波浪与满月》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Plovers, Waves, and Full Moon
works.blurb_zh: 千鸟从满月前翻飞而过，浪头在下方卷起白沫。上下两种涌动夹着深蓝夜色，月亮成为其中最安定的圆。
works.blurb_en: Plovers turn before the full moon as white surf curls below. Between two kinds of movement, the moon offers a steady circle in the blue night.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 满月并不自动等于“秋”。日本艺术中“赏月”与秋天关系极深，但若画面只有月亮而缺少雁、秋草等辅助季语，就不宜仅凭“Full Moon”强行判为秋季。网页可把“月”作为独立主题，并在季节分类上保持谨慎。
works.seasonal_note_en: A full moon does not automatically mean autumn. Moon-viewing has deep autumnal associations in Japanese culture, but when geese, autumn grasses, or other seasonal cues are absent, “full moon” alone should not force an autumn classification. It is safer to treat Moon as an independent theme and keep the seasonal label cautious.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹌鹑与罂粟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Quail and Poppies
works.blurb_zh: 鹌鹑挤在低处花叶间，一根罂粟茎独自伸向上方。贴地的鸟与高挑的花相对，让窄幅容下两种截然不同的姿态。
works.blurb_en: Quails gather low among leaves beneath one tall poppy stem. Grounded birds and a lifted flower occupy contrasting postures within the narrow frame.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《满月下的兔子》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Rabbits Under Full Moon
works.blurb_zh: 两只白兔停在月下草岸，浅浅轮廓从绿地中显出。蓝色水带隔开近处草地与高处圆月，夜色因此有了远近。
works.blurb_en: Two white rabbits sit on a grassy bank beneath the moon. A blue band of water separates their pale outlines from the distant light.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 满月并不自动等于“秋”。日本艺术中“赏月”与秋天关系极深，但若画面只有月亮而缺少雁、秋草等辅助季语，就不宜仅凭“Full Moon”强行判为秋季。网页可把“月”作为独立主题，并在季节分类上保持谨慎。
works.seasonal_note_en: A full moon does not automatically mean autumn. Moon-viewing has deep autumnal associations in Japanese culture, but when geese, autumn grasses, or other seasonal cues are absent, “full moon” alone should not force an autumn classification. It is safer to treat Moon as an independent theme and keep the seasonal label cautious.

works.title_en: Red-cheeked Bird and Red Plum Blossoms
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《红颊小鸟与红梅》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Red-cheeked Bird and Red Plum Blossoms
works.blurb_zh: 小鸟红颊与梅花相映，细枝几乎直达画顶。花朵只占零星几处，长长的枝线便显出早春尚未繁盛的清简。
works.blurb_en: A bird’s red cheek echoes scattered plum blossoms along tall shoots. The long, sparsely flowered lines suggest an early spring still unfolding.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 梅花是日本艺术中重要的早春信号之一；它常在寒意尚存时开放，因此“梅”所指向的并不是完全摆脱冬天后的暖春，而更接近冬末至初春的季节交界。
works.seasonal_note_en: Plum blossom is a major early-spring signal in Japanese art. Because it flowers while the cold still lingers, it often evokes the threshold from late winter into early spring rather than a fully established warm spring.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《雪坡上的公鸡》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Rooster on a Snowy Hillside
works.blurb_zh: 公鸡俯向雪坡，黑色尾羽高高扬起。斜岸与上挑的尾线拉开角度，把一低头的动作写得鲜明有力。
works.blurb_en: A rooster bends toward a snowy slope while dark tail feathers rise high. The angle between bank and tail gives the small action force.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 这里的冬季判断首先来自画面中明确的积雪。日本四季图像长期以雪和萧疏景物提示冬季；植物或鸟类在这里是对冬景的补充，而不是季节判定的唯一依据。
works.seasonal_note_en: The winter reading here is anchored first of all by visible snow. Japanese four-season imagery has long used snow and spare landscapes as clear signs of winter; the plant or bird supplements that setting rather than determining the season by itself.

works.title_en: Small Horned Owl in a Pine Tree
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《松树上的小角鸮》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Small Horned Owl in a Pine Tree
works.blurb_zh: 小角鸮贴着松干收拢身体，圆眼从深色羽面中显出。四周针叶细密，它的端坐却把目光留在一个安静的正面。
works.blurb_en: An owl gathers itself against pine, round eyes emerging from dark feathers. Dense needles surround a still, frontal presence.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《麻雀与竹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Sparrow and Bamboo
works.blurb_zh: 麻雀立在竹节之间，细爪扣住一段枝条。上下两丛尖叶留下中央空隙，使这只小鸟显得清楚而自在。
works.blurb_en: A sparrow grips a branch between bamboo joints. Pointed leaves above and below leave a clear opening for its small body.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《麻雀与竹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Sparrow and Bamboo
works.blurb_zh: 麻雀张翼离开细竹，羽尖向外散开。红竹与暗叶交错在旁，把这一下腾起衬成画面中最轻的一处。
works.blurb_en: A sparrow opens its wings beside slender bamboo. Red stems and dark leaves give its lifted feathers a light setting.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《麻雀与山茶》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Sparrows and Camellia
works.blurb_zh: 两只麻雀一飞一栖，山茶枝从它们之间穿过。两种姿态像相隔片刻的动作，让静止花枝旁有了时间的先后。
works.blurb_en: One sparrow flies while another perches beside camellia. Their poses suggest successive moments around the same still branch.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《雪中山茶与麻雀》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Sparrows and Camellia in Snow
works.blurb_zh: 麻雀在雪覆山茶间上下相应，一只振翼，一只沿枝停住。暖色花瓣从白雪旁显露，把寒意与生气放在很近的地方。
works.blurb_en: Two sparrows answer each other among snowy camellias, one winging upward and one resting. Warm petals appear beside snow, bringing cold and vitality close together.
works.seasonal_note_zh: “雪中山茶”在日本花鸟画中并不矛盾。山茶类花木常被用于寒季图景；大都会艺术博物馆亦收藏广重《雪覆山茶与麻雀》，并在其他秋冬花鸟屏风中将山茶类列入冬季意象。这里的“花开于雪中”尤其适合被理解为冬末、向春天过渡的物候瞬间。
works.seasonal_note_en: Snow and camellia are not contradictory in Japanese bird-and-flower imagery. Camellias appear in cold-season imagery, and The Met holds Hiroshige’s *Sparrow and Snow-covered Camellia*. In seasonal programs, camellia can function as a winter motif. The combination is especially evocative of late winter and the threshold of spring.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《麻雀与雪覆南天竹》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Sparrows and Snow-covered Nandina
works.blurb_zh: 南天竹的红果点在覆雪细枝上，麻雀从枝间交错而出。白雪与展开的翅羽相映，使密集的枝头仍保有轻快的空隙。
works.blurb_en: Red nandina berries punctuate snow-covered twigs as sparrows move between them. White snow and spread feathers keep the dense branchwork lively.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 这里的冬季判断首先来自画面中明确的积雪。日本四季图像长期以雪和萧疏景物提示冬季；植物或鸟类在这里是对冬景的补充，而不是季节判定的唯一依据。
works.seasonal_note_en: The winter reading here is anchored first of all by visible snow. Japanese four-season imagery has long used snow and spare landscapes as clear signs of winter; the plant or bird supplements that setting rather than determining the season by itself.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《燕子与花菖蒲》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Swallow and Iris
works.blurb_zh: 燕子从菖蒲叶间斜飞，深色花朵高出鸟身。叶线直而长，翅线短而急，两者把同一片空气分出不同节奏。
works.blurb_en: A swallow cuts across iris leaves below a dark flower. Long leaf lines and quick wing strokes set different rhythms in the same air.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《燕群与花菖蒲》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Swallows and Iris
works.blurb_zh: 燕群聚在画幅高处，菖蒲以几笔长叶从下方伸起。上下之间的留白宽阔，飞鸟的紧凑便更显灵动。
works.blurb_en: Swallows gather high above a few long iris leaves. The broad interval between them makes the compact group of birds feel nimble.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《燕子与罂粟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Swallow and Poppy
works.blurb_zh: 燕子转身掠过罂粟花茎，红花一高一低。柔薄花冠与尖长翅尾交替出现，画面像在缓慢生长中闪过一次飞行。
works.blurb_en: A swallow turns beside poppies placed high and low on the stem. Soft petals alternate with pointed wings and tail, a brief flight amid slower growth.

works.title_en: Tiger in the Bamboo Grove in the Rain
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《雨中竹林之虎》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Tiger in the Bamboo Grove in the Rain
works.blurb_zh: 竹叶与斜雨一同扫过纸面，虎伏在下方阴影里。大片倾斜线条压向低处，使藏身的兽影更显凝重。
works.blurb_en: Bamboo leaves and slanting rain sweep across the sheet above a tiger. The descending lines lend weight to the animal sheltered below.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《双鸟与绣球花》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Two Birds and Hydrangea
works.blurb_zh: 两只小鸟分处绣球花枝的上下，一只展翼，一只靠近花团。浅色花序把它们连成一段轻盈的枝间往来。
works.blurb_en: Two birds occupy different levels of a hydrangea branch, one spreading its wings. Pale flower clusters connect their movements through the stem.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《月下双马》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Two Horses Beneath the Moon
works.blurb_zh: 双马在蓝色月夜中并立，垂枝从高处罩下。马身的暖色集中在画面下半，让辽阔夜色有了一个近处的依靠。
works.blurb_en: Two horses stand together in a blue moonlit scene beneath hanging branches. Warm bodies in the lower half provide an intimate anchor for the night.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 满月并不自动等于“秋”。日本艺术中“赏月”与秋天关系极深，但若画面只有月亮而缺少雁、秋草等辅助季语，就不宜仅凭“Full Moon”强行判为秋季。网页可把“月”作为独立主题，并在季节分类上保持谨慎。
works.seasonal_note_en: A full moon does not automatically mean autumn. Moon-viewing has deep autumnal associations in Japanese culture, but when geese, autumn grasses, or other seasonal cues are absent, “full moon” alone should not force an autumn classification. It is safer to treat Moon as an independent theme and keep the seasonal label cautious.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《双燕与鸢尾》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Two Swallows and Irises
works.blurb_zh: 双燕在鸢尾上方交错，细长叶片向着飞鸟直立。简淡的底色把翅膀、花瓣和叶尖分开，每一道轮廓都能单独停看。
works.blurb_en: Two swallows cross above irises and upright leaves. The pale field separates wings, petals and pointed blades into distinct contours.

works.title_en: Wading Crane and Trailing Bush Clover
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《涉水鹤与垂枝胡枝子》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Wading Crane and Trailing Bush Clover
works.blurb_zh: 鹤俯身涉水，白羽紧贴垂落的胡枝子。斜向水带托住细腿，让密花、轻羽与流水在同一方向上缓缓相接。
works.blurb_en: A crane bends into the water beneath trailing bush clover. A sloping band supports its fine legs and joins flowers, feathers and current.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《鹡鸰与蔷薇》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Wagtail and Roses
works.blurb_zh: 鹡鸰从蔷薇花丛上方掠下，展开的翅尖指向空处。红花密集在一侧，鸟身的浅色让这次掠过格外清晰。
works.blurb_en: A wagtail sweeps over a dense bank of roses, wing tips opening into space. Pale feathers make its passage distinct beside the red blooms.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《梅枝上的莺》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Warbler on Plum Branch
works.blurb_zh: 绿羽小鸟沿折转的梅枝俯下，花朵只以疏疏细线点出。羽色与淡花之间的反差，让枝头的一次探身成为中心。
works.blurb_en: A green bird bends along an angular plum branch marked by lightly drawn blossoms. Its coloured body brings the small gesture into focus.
works.seasonal_note_zh: “梅与莺（梅に鶯）”是非常典型的迎春组合。日本诗歌与视觉艺术中，莺的初啼被视为春天到来的信号；与梅花并置后，这种“岁首、初春、新生”的意味尤其鲜明。甚至传统作品中也会让莺停在残雪覆枝的梅树上——春意可以在冬景尚未完全消失时到来。
works.seasonal_note_en: The pairing of plum and bush warbler (*ume ni uguisu*) is a classic harbinger of spring. In Japanese poetry and visual art, the warbler’s first song announces the coming of spring, and its pairing with plum intensifies associations with the New Year, early spring, and renewal. Traditional imagery can even place the bird on snow-covered plum branches: spring may arrive before winter has fully vanished.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《梅枝上的莺》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Warbler on Plum Branch
works.blurb_zh: 小鸟斜立在梅枝交叉处，长尾与高挑细枝相接。粗枝撑出明确的折角，淡花则把这份骨力轻轻柔化。
works.blurb_en: A bird perches where plum branches cross, its long tail meeting a rising shoot. Pale blossoms soften the firm angles of the wood.

works.blurb_zh: 梅枝从高处弯垂，小鸟倒悬般伏在细枝上。枝梢一直延向下方，把鸟身短促的动作接成一条悠长的曲线。
works.blurb_en: A plum branch bends down around a bird leaning beneath its perch. The trailing tip extends that brief gesture into a long curve.

works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Warbler on Red Plum Branch
works.blurb_zh: 红梅散落在疏直枝间，绿鸟横身探向一侧。花点的圆与枝线的直相对，使小小鸟身成为转折最柔和的地方。
works.blurb_en: Red plum blossoms dot sparse upright twigs beside a green bird reaching sideways. Rounded flowers and straight stems meet in the bird’s softer turn.

works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Warbler on Red Plum Branch
works.blurb_zh: 绿鸟从斜枝俯向空中，梅花在身后零星开放。老枝的曲折与细梢的轻直相衬，把探身的一瞬托得稳而不重。
works.blurb_en: A green bird leans outward from a sloping plum branch. Bent older wood and fine shoots support its momentary reach without weighing it down.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《白鹭与灯心草》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, White Heron and Rushes
works.blurb_zh: 白鹭几乎融进密密灯心草，只留下明亮羽身与长喙。深蓝水际和竖直草线围住它，使静止也显得有深度。
works.blurb_en: A white heron is partly enclosed by rushes, its pale body and long beak distinct within them. Blue water and vertical stems give its stillness depth.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《海棠枝上的白颊小鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, White-cheeked Bird on Aronia Branch
works.blurb_zh: 白颊小鸟坐在花枝弯处，长尾顺着枝干垂下。上下散开的花叶为它留出空隙，浅色脸颊便成了温和的焦点。
works.blurb_en: A white-cheeked bird rests at a bend in a flowering branch, its tail following the stem. Spaced blossoms leave its pale face as a gentle focus.

works.title_en: White-headed Bird Clinging to Ivy Vine
works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《攀附蔦藤的白头小鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, White-headed Bird Clinging to Ivy Vine
works.blurb_zh: 小鸟倒攀着蔦藤，叶片从高处一路疏疏垂落。枝线的纤细与鸟身的翻转相遇，使纸上的空处也有悬挂之感。
works.blurb_en: A bird clings upside down to trailing ivy. Fine stems and the inverted body make the open paper feel suspended around it.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《枫枝上的白头小鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, White-headed Bird on Maple Branch
works.blurb_zh: 白头小鸟低首贴近枫枝，深色羽身在红叶间收成圆团。几根垂下的细枝拉开距离，让这个紧凑姿态不显局促。
works.blurb_en: A white-headed bird bows close to maple, its dark body rounded among red leaves. Hanging twigs give the compact pose room.
works.seasonal_note_zh: 红叶、枫叶是日本艺术中最容易辨认的秋季物候之一。这里把作品归入秋季，主要依据的是季节性叶色，而不是鸟或动物本身。
works.seasonal_note_en: Maple foliage is one of the most legible autumnal signs in Japanese seasonal imagery. The autumn classification here is driven primarily by the changing leaves rather than by the accompanying bird or animal.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《海棠与燕子》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Wild Cherry and Swallows
works.blurb_zh: 三只燕子上下翻飞，花枝只从下角探出。连续的翅姿像几次相接的转弯，让细长纸面容下了一小段天空。
works.blurb_en: Three swallows turn at different heights above a branch entering from below. Successive wing positions give the narrow sheet a stretch of sky.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《山藤与鹀鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Wild Wisteria and Bunting
works.blurb_zh: 鹀鸟在野藤间俯身，细长藤线从鸟旁垂下。红褐色羽身是空纸上的一小处暖意，枝叶则把它轻轻悬住。
works.blurb_en: A bunting bends among wild wisteria, a fine tendril falling beside it. Its reddish body makes a small warmth held lightly by the branchwork.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《棣棠花与灰雀》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Yamabuki and Bullfinch
works.blurb_zh: 灰雀张翼掠向棣棠，黑羽与黄花形成清楚对照。花枝斜斜伸过水色，接住了飞鸟靠近的一瞬。
works.blurb_en: A bullfinch opens its wings toward yellow yamabuki blossoms. The sloping branch against blue receives the bird’s approaching movement.

works.image_alt_zh: 歌川广重《木兰与文鸟》
works.image_alt_en: Utagawa Hiroshige, Magnolia and Java Sparrow
works.blurb_zh: 文鸟沿木兰枝俯身，浅色花朵在高处向外张开。细枝间留出的宽阔空处，使花的舒展与鸟的低回各自清晰。
works.blurb_en: A Java sparrow bends along magnolia beneath pale, outward-opening flowers. The wide spaces between twigs distinguish the flower’s expansion from the bird’s downward turn.
